# Anima - Interspecies Communication Platform

This project aims to create an innovative React application that enables communication with animals and non-verbal individuals through:
- Microexpression analysis
- Biometric signal interpretation  
- Environmental context reading
- Real-time emotion and intent translation

## Key Technologies
- React.js for the frontend interface
- Computer vision for microexpression detection
- Sensor integration for biometric data
- Machine learning for pattern recognition
- Real-time data processing

## Project Goals
- Give voice to the voiceless
- Bridge dimensional communication gaps
- Create accessible communication tools
- Advance interspecies understanding

## Development Focus
- Prioritize accessibility and inclusivity
- Implement ethical AI practices
- Ensure privacy and consent considerations
- Build modular, extensible architecture
